papers.headline: Learning a model of non-stationary nuisances with non-local correlations for object detection
papers.summary: We tackle the problem of detecting faint objects in multivariate data corrupted by a strong and spatially correlated nuisance component in the low-sample regime.
papers.title: Learning a model of non-stationary nuisances with non-local correlations for object detection

papers.headline: r-Process Abundance Variations in Globular Clusters as Fossils of Turbulent Mixing
papers.summary: Several metal-poor Galactic globular clusters exhibit substantial star-to-star r-process abundance variations at nearly fixed [Fe/H], with the ensemble suggesting smaller variations toward increasing metallicity.
papers.title: r-Process Abundance Variations in Globular Clusters as Fossils of Turbulent Mixing

papers.headline: Connecting field-level and n-point function measurements of galaxy bias
papers.summary: Precise measurements of galaxy bias parameters are essential for extracting cosmological information from galaxy surveys.
papers.title: Connecting field-level and n-point function measurements of galaxy bias
papers.authors: H. Huang, H. Rubira, F. Schmidt
